com.esignal.jstandard.event

Interface StatusEnum<T extends java.lang.Enum<?>>

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DbcCodes.DBCAPI, DbcCodes.DBCAPI_ERROR, DbcCodes.DBCAPI_NOTIFY, DbcCodes.eSTATUS, DbcCodes.eSTATUS_NO_DATA, DbcCodes.HIST_RESPONSE, DbcCodes.HIST_RESPONSE_ERROR, DbcCodes.NEWSSRV_RESPONSE_ERROR, DbcCodes.PORT_EVENT, DbcCodes.TICSRV_RESPONSE, DbcCodes.TICSRV_RESPONSE_ERROR, DbcCodes.UNKNOWN, LightWeightCodes.LWAPI, LightWeightCodes.LWAPI_ERROR, StatusEnum.TYPE

    public interface StatusEnum<T extends java.lang.Enum<?>>
    Some of these method has to be implemented for every enum since enums cannot be extended. But the enums that represents an internal Status should implment this interface. For example, all the enums of DbcCodes.

      • find

        StatusEnum<?> find(int code)
        Finds the given code in this type of enum. But if it can't find it then it will return Unknown status.
